name: Mlilwane Wildlife Sanctuary
subtitle: Mlilwane is a 4,560 ha sanctuary in the Ezulwini Valley, proclaimed in 1961 on the Reilly family farm.

facts.label: Location
facts.value: In the Ezulwini Valley, between Mbabane and Manzini

facts.label: Site history
facts.value: Founded on the Reilly family farm, whose environment tin mining and farming had drastically modified

facts.label: Shape
facts.value: A thin sliver of land, at most 4 km wide, too narrow for large herds

facts.label: Origins of conservation
facts.value: Formal conservation in Eswatini began in the late 1950s when Ted Reilly recognised the decline of wildlife

facts.label: Big Game Parks
facts.value: The head of state delegated administration of the Game Act to Big Game Parks

parts.text: Mlilwane is a 4,560 ha sanctuary in the Ezulwini Valley, proclaimed in 1961 on the Reilly family farm. It is described by its managers as Eswatini's pioneer conservation area. Big Game Parks, which runs it, also administers the national Game Act.
